current_activity: 1st Battalion landing unopposed at Aola Bay
notes: Miller, ch. VII: the Aola Force included 1,700 men of the 1st Battalion, 147th Infantry, and landed unopposed at Aola Bay on 4 November 1942 under Colonel W. B. Tuttle, after which command passed to Vandegrift. The claim locates the regiment by that 1st Battalion landing, the body Miller names. Confidence 0.5: Miller only in this increment.
